focus: Q6: design completed-run extension for deep-research and deep-review — traced on_completed_session (halt vs synthesis asymmetry), step_apply_lifecycle_request, ledger stems, convergence cap/floor, max-duration clock; specified completed-continue/--extend design with config fields, run_extended event, reducer/segment/synthesis treatment, files and tests
noveltyJustification: 9 of 10 findings were fully new (completed-session asymmetry, ledger stem vocabulary, createdAt clock trap, dormant segment seam, confirm-gate extension precedent); finding 3 partially overlaps iteration 2's cap reading
answeredQuestions: Q6: Design completed-run extension for deep-research and deep-review. Today a completed packet halts (step_classify_session on_completed_session) and the completed-continue lineage mode is deferred, so the only way to add iterations is --restart, which archives the registry, strategy and questions. How should an in-place extension work (completed-continue or an --extend=N flag): which config fields change, which ledger event records it, how the reducer, convergence floor and synthesis treat pre- and post-extension iterations, and which files and tests change?
ruledOut: --extend=N as a standalone flag divorced from the lineage mode (same machinery, splits vocabulary)
Re-stamping createdAt to reset the duration clock (erases elapsed-time audit)
Emitting the extension as a plain resumed event (loses budget-top-up provenance in the ledger)

label: Completed-session branches are asymmetric: research on_completed_session halts and releases the lock (deep-research.yaml:515-519); review on_completed_session skip_to phase_synthesis (deep-review.yaml:584-587). status:complete is stamped by step_update_config_status after synthesis+spec write-back (deep-research.yaml:1923-1927, deep-review.yaml:2165; initial value 'initialized' at deep-research.yaml:565).

A confirm-mode extension path already exists inside the loop: gate_pre_synthesis.on_B 'Run more iterations (increase max)' raises maxIterations and, on maxDurationReached, maxDurationMinutes, then returns to phase_loop (deep-research.yaml:1766-1771; deep-review.yaml:1883). The workflow already treats budget fields as mutable despite fileProtection 'immutable', which binds the LEAF and optimizer lockedFields, not the workflow (step_update_config_status edits config).

The convergence cap needs no change for a raised maxIterations: convergence.cjs:1049 reads config.maxIterations; iterationCount>=maxIterations (:1115-1124) is the terminal STOP outranking every veto; minIterations (:1051,:1159-1161) is a research-only CONTINUE floor inert once count exceeds it. Raising maxIterations re-arms the loop because the reducer counts all type:iteration rows as one continuous run.

The max-duration clock is the extension trap: step_check_max_duration computes elapsed from config.createdAt against maxDurationMinutes (deep-research.yaml:882-902; deep-review.yaml:932-951); its note says resume keeps createdAt and restart resets it. An in-place extension keeps createdAt, so a packet near its ceiling re-stops on the first post-extension check unless maxDurationMinutes is raised; re-stamping createdAt would erase elapsed-time audit.

Ledger vocabulary is closed: research legacy rows upcast through LEGACY_EVENT_STEMS (legacy-compatibility.ts:32-71) into deep_research.run_resumed/run_restarted (schema.ts:263-278, scope fields :741-742); unknown event names are refused. Review appends canonical stems directly (deep_review.run_resumed at deep-review.yaml:469,484; run_restarted :777). Neither schema has an extension stem; deep_review.run_completed is reserved (deep-review-ledger-types.ts:646).

completed-continue is already the reserved name — in config lineage.deferredModes, flag docs (research.md:109 'deferred and rejected'), both note_deferred_branches strings (deep-research.yaml:514; deep-review.yaml:538) and the Lifecycle Branch Contract (loop-protocol.md:119-146). Implementing it = moving it to allowedModes + one classify branch + one stem; a bare --extend flag needs the same machinery while diverging vocabulary.

Recommended shape: new stem deep_research.run_extended/deep_review.run_extended mirroring run_resumed fields plus extension:{addedIterations,priorMaxIterations,newMaxIterations,priorMaxDurationMinutes,newMaxDurationMinutes,priorStatus:'complete'}; config mutation keeps sessionId/generation/createdAt, sets status complete->active, maxIterations+=N (cumulative), maxDurationMinutes+=M, lineage.continuedFromRun=<count>; pre-classify mutation lands classify on resume; lifecycle-taxonomy.cjs unchanged (extension is not a STOP_REASONS value).

Segment seam exists but is unwired: current_segment reads 'Latest segment_start event segment, else 1' (deep-research.yaml:1737) and iteration rows may carry segment (convergence-reference-only.md:46), yet nothing emits segment_start; the extended event can carry the boundary or stay the sole marker, with post-extension iterations optionally tagged segment:2.

Edge: under stopPolicy=convergence an extension re-stops immediately because all_questions_answered (convergence.cjs:1149-1150) is still true when the question set is unchanged; couple --extend with inbox question injection (research side only — review has no question surface per iteration 3) or document the need for convergence-mode=off/max-iterations during the extension window.

Change surface: commands deep/{research,review}.md flag tables; deep-{research,review}.yaml lineage_mode description+note_deferred_branches+new completed-continue handling; regenerated contract.markdown+presentation.txt; deep-research-ledger-schema.ts/legacy-compatibility.ts (new stem+upcast+read shape); deep-review-ledger-types.ts; loop-protocol.md contract row; config assets allowedModes; tests: workflow-restart-lifecycle.vitest.ts, deep-review-auto-restart-contract.vitest.ts, ledger/upcast/reducer-parity suites, telemetry tolerance for two completed rows per sessionId. Synthesis path unchanged (iteration-*.md glob + whole-block spec fence replace is idempotent).

Q6 premise corrected: 'a completed packet halts' holds only for deep-research; deep-review re-runs phase_synthesis on a completed packet — extension design must preempt the skip_to when lineage_mode=completed-continue.

fileProtection 'deep-research-config.json: immutable' is advisory against LEAF/optimizer writes; the workflow already mutates config (status:complete, gate_pre_synthesis.on_B budget raises) — an extension codifies a bounded mutation allowlist rather than breaking a real invariant.

direction: --extend=N as a standalone flag divorced from lineage modes
reason: Needs identical machinery (classify branch, event, config mutation) while splitting the documented vocabulary; completed-continue is already the reserved name.

direction: Re-stamping config.createdAt to reset the duration clock
reason: Erases elapsed-time audit and breaks elapsedMinutes telemetry; raising maxDurationMinutes is the honest budget bump the confirm gate already prescribes.

direction: Emitting the extension as a plain resumed event
reason: Makes a budget top-up indistinguishable from an ordinary resume in the ledger and dashboard Lifecycle section; violates provenance the ledger exists to carry.
